September 21, 2026


At the Saskatchewan Nuclear Energy Forum in Toronto this week, Cameco CEO Tim Gitzel joined[Scott Moe](https://facebook.com/182365048474566) and former Prime Minister Stephen Harper for a fireside chat on leading global nuclear industry development. The forum highlighted Saskatchewan's strengths across the nuclear value chain, from world-class uranium resources to innovation and supply chain development. We're thrilled to be part of the growing momentum behind nuclear energy and the discussions shaping its future. As the world looks for clean, secure and reliable energy solutions, Saskatchewan has an important story to tell, and Cameco is proud to help tell it.
